name: East Timor
famous_for: Atauro Island (world's most biodiverse coral reef system), Christo Rei monument, Mount Ramelau sacred sunrise, and Tais woven textiles.
tourists: Approx. 80,000 visitors; famous for Atauro Island diving, Jaco Island uninhabited beach, and Dare memorial museum.
must_know: In Timorese culture, the saltwater crocodile is revered as the sacred ancestor 'Lafaek' who formed the island of Timor according to creation myth.
fun_fact: Marine surveys conducted around Atauro Island discovered the highest average reef fish diversity per dive anywhere on Earth.
